data.exact_reserve_text: In 2015, there has been an overall surplus of GBP 4.8m (2014 deficit of GBP 1m). The surplus is primarily driven by reserve releases on the 2013 and prior year of account due to better than expected claims experience in the marine and energy classes of business.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported an overall surplus of GBP 4.8 million in 2015, indicating a release of prior year reserves. This favorable development was primarily driven by better than expected claims experience in the marine and energy classes of business for the 2013 and prior years of account.
raw_causal_phrases: reserve releases on the 2013 and prior year of account
better than expected claims experience in the marine and energy classes of business

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure of -4.8m is taken from the narrative on page 18, which explicitly states an 'overall surplus of GBP 4.8m' from 'reserve releases on the 2013 and prior year of account'. A calculation from the gross claims development triangle on page 17 for years 2011-2013 yields a release of -2.279m, which is lower than the narrative figure. The narrative is considered more authoritative for the overall prior year movement.
